protocol.requested: Matched original ELISa MCMC and CPU/GPU hybrid on Ada
protocol.model: Original detached, circular, synchronous, reflected 12-degree facet binary with blackbody spectra and fixed linear limb darkening. Direct original phase mapping; 28 B, V and bolometric observations.
protocol.execution: Original public fit lifecycle. Original walker multiprocessing on both paths. Shared native hybrid evaluates actual original selected stellar faces in one GPU owner on logical CPU 16 (SMT sibling of CPU 0). Each worker count uses logical 0..N-1, one per physical core. All rows run in isolation one after another. Old direct serial hybrid gets a separate same-workload control.

prespecified_accuracy.mesh_check: original 12/8/6-degree empirical diagnostic, 0.1 sigma at generating point and two initial walkers; withheld densities remain failures

protocol.timing: End-to-end original fit includes setup, 32 physical one-phase preflights, pool or GPU service start/shutdown, JIT, transfers, device synchronization, sampling, fit summarization and final R-squared. Compute rates using measured evaluated full light curves. Save additional sampling-only and full process wall. Trace instrumentation is the same across paths.
protocol.publication: Existing codex/gpu-resident-roche-pipeline branch, coordinated with the regular publisher; full private logs and proposal traces retained.

source_manifest_scope: Original thirty matched timings and initial serial control. The second serial control additionally enabled the explicit post-initialization emcee seed. Each row records its benchmark driver hash.
